purpose: Open the customer context read-only after Foundation Readiness and capture page/list/action/field context before any customer write gate.
acceptanceCriteria: playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE context is proven before any customer page interaction.
The customer page/context is accepted only with visible page title and customer-list or customer-card signals.
Screenshots include enough checkpoints to show page context, list/card state, relevant actions and visible setup/dependency fields when available.
No customer, template, setup, document, draft, Preview Posting, Posting, payment or API shortcut is executed.
Result states what customer context was observed and what remains unproven for customer creation, sales and posting.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: PWS-FF-001 observed Number Series read-only with seven Universaarl U-* rows, checkbox context, Lines context and Page Inspection. Foundation Readiness now permits a single customer read-first probe but no customer write gate.
nextStepDecision.reason: Debitoren (Customers) are the smallest useful Master Data surface after Foundation read-first evidence. They support training, handbook, O2C planning and data-request validation without creating records.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Customer context can be inspected read-only without setup or master-data writes.
Vendor context should follow customer context to reuse the same screenshot QA pattern.
Item/service context has more product posting, UOM and inventory dependencies; inspect after customer/vendor.

queueChangesMade: Foundation Readiness now distinguishes Master Data read-first from Master Data writes.
nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It converts Foundation evidence into the first customer-facing Master Data surface while preserving no-write gates.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not click New/Neu or edit templates.
Do not claim customer creation, sales readiness or posting readiness from page visibility.
requiredPreparation: Use screenshot QA with multiple checkpoints, not a single endpoint screenshot.
